FIELDS.NAME: Creamy Delights Ice Cream Shop
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Creamy Way, Ice Cream Town, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creamy Delights Ice Cream Shop, we specialize in providing a delightful selection of premium homemade ice cream and dairy products. Our operations focus on ensuring the highest quality ingredients and customer experience while maintaining a safe environment. We operate with a state-of-the-art ice cream making process, utilizing fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Our shop is designed for retail, with a friendly counter service where customers can enjoy scoops, sundaes, and seasonal specialties.

All staff members undergo comprehensive food safety training to uphold strict hygiene standards and minimize the risk of foodborne illnesses. We meticulously label all our products with clear ingredient lists and allergen information to inform our customers, demonstrating our commitment to transparency and safety.

To ensure optimal operations, we conduct regular equipment maintenance and cleaning according to an established schedule. Additional security measures, such as surveillance systems, are implemented to protect our shop and assets, especially given our location in a moderately busy area.

Our dedication to compliance with local health regulations and proactive risk assessments helps us identify potential hazards and implement necessary improvements. Overall, our commitment to quality products, exceptional customer service, and safe operational practices defines the core of Creamy Delights Ice Cream Shop.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a customer slipped on a wet floor in the shop, resulting in a minor injury. The claim was settled for $1,200, and safety measures have since been improved to prevent similar incidents in the future. Status: Closed.
